intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Winter Park for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from December 3 (Christmas in the Park in Winter Park) through December 20 (Gingerbread at The Alfond Inn), with Winter on the Avenue (December 4) and the Winter Park Christmas Parade (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Winter Park

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Winter Park
  • 3 free events: Christmas in the Park in Winter Park, Winter on the Avenue and the Winter Park Christmas Parade
  • Meet Santa: Winter on the Avenue lights the Central Park tree with Santa on December 4
  • Parades and tree lightings: Christmas in the Park (December 3), Winter on the Avenue (December 4) and the parade on Park Avenue (December 5)
  • Trains: none in town; the free Holiday Train runs at Lake Eola Park in Orlando on December 4 to 20
  • Season: December 3 to December 20

Planning a bigger day out? Winter Park families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Orlando, which covers Dazzling Nights at Harry P. Leu Gardens, SeaWorld's Christmas Celebration, Holidays at Universal Orlando Resort and the Eola Wonderland Christmas Tree Show.
